note: Registry verification could not be completed. The web_search tool was unavailable (backend connection refused) and all direct registry/profile sources returned errors: zaubacorp.com and instafinancials.com returned HTTP 403 (blocked), thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 404, Google returned HTTP 429, DuckDuckGo timed out, and Bing returned only irrelevant results (Google Voice / Google Drive pages) for every query attempted. Therefore no CIN/LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status or audited revenue figures could be sourced. All such fields are set to null rather than guessed. 'ARIHANT COMPUTERS' is a very common Indian trade name (multiple proprietorships, partnerships and private limited companies across states), so no single legal entity can be matched to this input without a CIN, GSTIN or registered address. Role is recorded as 'unknown' — the input gives no evidence of manufacturing vs trading, and the declared HS 851762 (network/telecom equipment) is not evidence of either. Per project rules this is NOT a rejection: there is no evidence the entity does not exist, is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt — the entity simply could not be identified or verified with the tools available. Recommend re-running with a working search backend and, ideally, a CIN/GSTIN or registered address from the client to disambiguate.
